result.markdown: --- title: "[embedding.EmbeddingNVIDIA]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-class}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Creates an embedding function provider backed by NVIDIA's NIM embedding models. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/posit-dev/raghilda/blob/docs-embedding-providers/src/raghilda/_embedding_nvidia.py#L14-L189){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python embedding.EmbeddingNVIDIA( model="nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2", base_url="https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1", api_key=None, batch_size=20, truncate="NONE" ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Implements the [EmbeddingProvider](`raghilda.EmbeddingProvider`) interface. NVIDIA's embedding API is compatible with the OpenAI client library. It supports differentiated query vs document embeddings via the `input_type` parameter. Browse available models and get API keys at [NVIDIA NIM](https://build.nvidia.com/nvidia). NVIDIA also provides Docker images for self-hosting NIM models. When running a model locally or on your own infrastructure, set the `base_url` parameter to point to your self-hosted endpoint (e.g., `"http://localhost:8000/v1"`). ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [model]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The NVIDIA embedding model to use. Default is "nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2". [base_url]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The base URL for the NVIDIA API. Default is "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1". Change this to point to a self-hosted NIM container (e.g., `"http://localhost:8000/v1"`). [api_key]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : The API key for authenticating with NVIDIA. If None, it will use the NVIDIA_API_KEY environment variable if set. Not required when using a self-hosted NIM container. [batch_size]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[20]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : The number of texts to process in each batch when calling the API. [truncate]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["NONE"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Truncation strategy. Default is "NONE". Set to "END" to truncate inputs that exceed the model's max token length. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#85ff3e69 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} from raghilda.embedding import EmbeddingNVIDIA, EmbedInputType # Using NVIDIA's hosted API provider = EmbeddingNVIDIA(model="nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2") # Or using a self-hosted NIM container provider = EmbeddingNVIDIA( model="nvidia/llama-nemotron-embed-1b-v2", base_url="http://localhost:8000/v1", ) # Embed documents for indexing doc_embeddings = provider.embed( ["Hello world", "Testing embeddings"], input_type=EmbedInputType.DOCUMENT, ) # Embed a query for search query_embedding = provider.embed( ["How do I test embeddings?"], input_type=EmbedInputType.QUERY, ) ``` :::
